water.name: Land
water.rule: Canadian cartographic boundaries or Natural Earth land sampled seven times per hex.

water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Sea averaging more than 200 m deep and not beside land.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea beside land, or averaging up to 200 m deep.

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Inland water from Natural Earth and NRCan land cover; a lake hex's depth is shown as 0 m or below.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation inside the hex under 85 m.

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation ≥ 260 m, or mean elevation ≥ 2,300 m.
